text: Love your wife, but don't act jealous— that will only invite her to hurt you.
If you let yourself fall under the spell of a woman, she will walk all over you.
You had best stay away from an immoral woman, or you will be caught in her traps.
Do not spend too much time with a woman who sings to entertain men— she can use many tricks to take control of you.
Do not gaze too long at a virgin— if you talk her into having sex, you will have to pay a fine and marry her.
Don't let yourself be controlled by a desire for prostitutes, or you will lose everything that you inherited.
So don't look for them; stay off the lonely streets where they are found.
Don't stare at a married woman with a beautiful figure. A woman's beauty can set men on fire and has led many astray.
Never have dinner or drinks with someone else's wife. To fall in love with her is to fall to your death.
Don't desert old friends— like bottles of aged wine, they bring cheer more than new ones.
Don't be jealous of sinners who receive praise; you never can tell how their life will end.
Don't look for happiness where ungodly people do. You know they won't always get away with their sins.

Stay away from those who are able to kill you, and you won't live in fear of death. To be near them is to walk through a field full of traps or across a ledge high on the city walls— make one false step and your life is over.
Do your best to know your close neighbors, but only ask the wise ones for advice.
Speak with the wise about the Law of God Most High.
Ask godly people over for dinner and be proud that you fear the Lord.
Craftsmen receive praise if their work shows skill, and the leaders of a nation will be honored for wise words.
But loud, reckless leaders are hated and feared.
